title: Lineage Index
body:
This index coordinates files and data detailing the familial and genetic history of Dan Frank, divided into documentary ancestry records and genomic profiles.

## Files

- [[wiki/self/lineage/family-tree]] — Extracted from Ancestry.com GEDCOM data detailing 515 individuals across multiple generations, including maternal WV roots and paternal Jewish immigrant origins.
- [[wiki/self/lineage/23andme-genomics]] — 23andMe genomic data, including ancestry composition, chromosome painting, and Neanderthal variant percentiles.
- [[wiki/self/lineage/hybrid-analysis]] — Speculative synthesis cross-referencing documentary genealogy with genomic results to map biological and cultural heritage.

## Gaps
- Further integration of genomic health traits with known ancestral lineage.
